Compare yourself to who you were last month.
Mute three accounts that make you feel behind.
Write down one thing you did better this week.

slides.title: SET THESE 5 GOALS BEFORE JANUARY DOES IT FOR YOU

DAYS LEFT
IN 2026
slides.sub: January resolutions start at zero. Yours don't have to.

slides.text: Read one chapter a day before your phone.
slides.sub: Start with the Gospel of John.

slides.text: Train 3 days a week. Walk the other 4.
Read 10 pages a day. Fiction counts.
Save something from every paycheck.
slides.sub: Pick the amount now, even if it's small.

slides.text: Call one person a week you've been meaning to.

slides.title:
PICK ONE.
START TODAY.
slides.text: The System turns these into daily quests with stats you can watch rise. Coming soon.

slides.title: STOP SAYING YOU'RE TOO BUSY TO PRAY

slides.text: You plan your whole day and never ask God about it.
slides.sub: Then wonder why it feels heavy.

slides.text: Name three things you're thankful for. Out loud.
slides.sub: Start with breath and a bed.

slides.text: Be honest about yesterday. Ask for help with today.
Pick two people and pray for them by name.
slides.sub: Keep a short list on your phone.

slides.text: “…rising up a great while before day, he went out… and there prayed.”
slides.sub: Jesus made time. So can we.

slides.title:
5 MINUTES.

scenes.cap: FAITH: DID YOU OPEN YOUR BIBLE THIS WEEK?

WEALTH: DO YOU KNOW WHERE IT WENT?

slides.text: Hours of sleep left in 2026 if you get 7 a night: 329. Don't spend them on a feed.
Phone on the charger. Outside the bedroom.
slides.sub: Alarm clock if you need one.

slides.text: Write tomorrow's top 3 on paper.
slides.sub: Wake up already knowing the mission.

slides.text: Lay out clothes, Bible, water.
“I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep…”
slides.sub: End the day with God, not a screen.
